sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages fifty-three to sixty, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: roundabout crash-reduction percentages, marking colors and line patterns, and signal meanings are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; these are picture pages, so only text facts were taken: route markers, marking diagrams and roundabout drawings were not read as pictures, guide sign colors were not paired with the sample sign labels, and the two-lane roundabout lane-assignment captions on physical page sixty extracted in three conflicting variants, so only the summary lane rules printed beside the drawing were used; the manual's statements that centerlines are white on multi-lane highways and that a steady yellow X permits cautious use of a lane are recorded as the manual states them.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
